subject: Future Tech
title: SLA: Light into Solid
description: One-minute skill: SLA: Light into Solid.

hook.text: Stereolithography uses a UV laser to harden liquid resin into solid plastic.

buildup.text: A build platform dips into a vat of photosensitive resin.

discovery.text: SLA achieves layer heights down to 25 microns, four times finer than typical FDM.

twist.text: Resin is messy, toxic before curing, and parts need post-processing in UV chambers.

climax.text: Dentists use SLA daily for crowns, aligners, and surgical guides.

punchline.text: A beam of light turns liquid into precision solid.

quiz.question: What type of light does SLA use to cure resin?
